environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image deployed as ECS Fargate task in private subnet (10.0.128.0/20). Service is fronted by an internal NLB (scheme=internal) registered as a VPC Endpoint Service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f). Consumer access requires explicit principal allowlisting via the endpoint service's allowed-principals list (only arn:aws:iam::111222333444:root is permitted). The VPC has no internet gateway, no NAT gateway on the private subnet, and the security group on the NLB target (sg-0xdeadbeef) allows inbound TCP/8080 only from the VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/16. Route tables for the private subnet contain only local routes (10.0.0.0/16 -> local) and a VPC endpoint route for S3/DynamoDB. DNS resolution for the service is only available via the interface endpoint's private DNS name within the consumer VPC.

config.load_balancer: internal NLB, scheme=internal, no public IP
config.internet_access: none - no IGW, no NAT on task subnet
config.dns: private DNS via interface endpoint only
